summary: 在位六年，高平破敌、三征淮南、北伐收复三关，以整军与改革为北宋统一奠基的英年早逝之主。
summary_en: An emperor who died young after only six years on the throne, breaking the enemy at Gaoping, campaigning thrice in Huainan, and recovering the Three Passes in a northern expedition, whose military reorganization and reforms laid the foundation for Northern Song unification.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 郭威崩，柴荣即位，是为世宗。
timeline.summary_en: Guo Wei dies and Chai Rong takes the throne, becoming Shizong.

timeline.title: 沿用显德年号
timeline.summary: 郭威正月改广顺四年为显德元年；荣即位后沿用，朝廷人事更始。
timeline.summary_en: Guo Wei changes Guangshun 4 into Xiande 1 in the first month; Chai Rong keeps it after his accession as court personnel are renewed.

timeline.title: 高平之战
timeline.summary: 亲征败北汉、契丹联军于高平，战后整肃禁军，确立权威。
timeline.summary_en: Campaigns in person and defeats the allied Northern Han and Khitan army at Gaoping, then purges the palace army and establishes his authority.

timeline.title: 毁佛铸钱
timeline.summary: 限寺减僧，毁铜佛铸钱，以充财政军备。
timeline.summary_en: Restricts temples and reduces the clergy, melting bronze Buddha statues for coin to fund finances and armament.

timeline.title: 征淮南
timeline.summary_en: Campaigns in person against Southern Tang; the Xiande armies are invigorated.

timeline.title: 经略淮南
timeline.summary: 多次征南唐，南压强敌，指向江北诸州。
timeline.summary_en: Campaigns repeatedly against Southern Tang, pressing the strong enemy in the south toward the prefectures north of the river.

timeline.title: 江北十四州
timeline.summary: 南唐献江北之地，周取十四州。
timeline.summary_en: Southern Tang cedes the lands north of the river and Zhou takes fourteen prefectures.

timeline.title: 北伐契丹
timeline.summary: 亲率北伐，收复关南部分州县，病重回师。
timeline.summary_en: Leads the northern expedition in person, recovers some Guannan prefectures, and returns gravely ill.

timeline.title: 收复三关
timeline.summary: 北伐取关南三州，混一之志未竟而病重。
timeline.summary_en: The northern expedition takes three prefectures in Guannan; his ambition to unify goes unfulfilled as his illness worsens.

timeline.title: 遗命范质等
timeline.summary: 病重托孤于范质等，身后旋有陈桥之变。
timeline.summary_en: Gravely ill, he entrusts his heir to Fan Zhi and others; the Chenqiao Mutiny follows soon after his death.

timeline.title: 世宗崩
timeline.summary: 崩于开封，子宗训年幼继位，旋有陈桥兵变，周禅于宋。
timeline.summary_en: Dies at Kaifeng; his young son Zongxun succeeds, the Chenqiao Mutiny soon follows, and Zhou yields to Song.

timeline.title: 整军均田
timeline.summary: 选练禁军、限制寺院、均定田赋，国力回升。
timeline.summary_en: Selects and trains the palace army, restricts temples, and equalizes land taxes; state power recovers.

bio_md:
# 后周世宗 · 主要事迹

柴荣在位不过六年，却是五代末局里承前启后的枢纽：上接养父后周太祖郭威的草创之业，下开[[n-song-tai-zu|宋太祖]]赵匡胤的统一之局。本页以《旧五代史·周书·世宗纪》为年表主线，辅以《新五代史·周本纪》与《资治通鉴》编年。

显德元年，郭威崩，柴荣即位，沿用显德年号。北汉与契丹联军压境，他亲征迎战，败之于高平，战后整肃禁军，一战确立新君权威。内政上同样果决：显德二年限寺减僧、毁铜佛铸钱以充财政军备；显德间又选练禁军、均定田赋，使国力回升。

南方，他连年亲征南唐，显德三年起兵，四至五年间反复经略淮南，至显德五年南唐献出江北之地，周取十四州，把疆界推到长江北岸——这正是后来[[n-tang-houzhu|南唐后主]]一系被动局面的先声。显德六年，他转而北伐契丹，收复关南三关州县，兵锋直指幽州方向，却于军中病重，只得回师。

回到开封后，他托孤于范质等，旋即驾崩，子宗训年幼继位。次年陈桥兵变，周禅于宋，他未竟的混一之志由宋人接手完成。史家每论其英年早逝：若得永年，宋史的开局或许改写——这桩假设，正是读五代末史时最耐人寻味的关节。

bio_parts_en.value: Chai Rong reigned barely six years, yet he was the hinge between what came before and after at the close of the Five Dynasties: he inherited the newly founded enterprise of his adoptive father Guo Wei, Taizu of Later Zhou, and opened the way to the unification completed under

Zhao Kuangyin. This page builds its chronology on the "Annals of Shizong" in the Zhou shu of the Old History of the Five Dynasties, supplemented by the "Zhou Basic Annals" in the New History of the Five Dynasties and the Zizhi Tongjian.

In Xiande 1 Guo Wei died and Chai Rong succeeded, keeping the Xiande era name. When the allied armies of Northern Han and the Khitans pressed the border, he campaigned in person and defeated them at Gaoping; after the battle he purged and reorganized the palace army, establishing a new ruler's authority in a single stroke. His domestic policy was equally decisive: in Xiande 2 he restricted temples, reduced the clergy, and melted bronze Buddha statues for coin to fund finances and armament; across the Xiande years he further selected and trained the palace army and equalized land taxes, bringing state power back up.

In the south he campaigned against Southern Tang year after year, raising armies in Xiande 3 and maneuvering repeatedly in Huainan through Xiande 4 and 5, until in Xiande 5 Southern Tang ceded the lands north of the river and Zhou took fourteen prefectures, pushing the frontier to the north bank of the Yangzi, the very precursor of the passive position later faced by the line of

bio_parts_en.label: Li Yu, last ruler of Southern Tang

bio_parts_en.value:
. In Xiande 6 he turned to a northern expedition against the Khitans, recovered the Three Passes and prefectures of Guannan with his spearhead pointed toward Youzhou, but fell gravely ill in the field and had to turn back.

Back in Kaifeng he entrusted his young heir to Fan Zhi and others and died soon after; his son Zongxun succeeded as a child. The next year came the Chenqiao Mutiny, and Zhou yielded to Song; his unfinished ambition of unification was taken up and completed by the Song. Historians often dwell on his early death: had he been granted long years, the opening chapter of Song history might have been rewritten. That counterfactual is the most thought-provoking knot in reading the history of the late Five Dynasties.
